en: Vintage illustrated postcard divided into small scenes. One shows the Great Sphinx and pyramids with people and camels in the desert. Another shows a palm grove with water in the foreground and figures or animals by the shore. A third view shows pyramids near a river with people and animals in the water. Decorative French captions appear above two scenes. In the blank area to the right there is a handwritten dedication reading "To Maggie with love."
